# Mushafuk

> Free, ad-free Madinah mushaf online: 604 Quran pages, with Arabic tafsir and translations on linked hosts. https://mushafuk.online

Mushafuk.online is a reading website. The Arabic text is the Madinah mushaf, page by page. Each public page is static HTML. Audio is recited ayah by ayah from EveryAyah. There is no login and no paid content.

## Start here

- [Home](https://mushafuk.online/): Arabic entrance
- [Quran, page 1](https://mushafuk.online/page/1/): first mushaf page; pages run from 1 to 604
- [Surah index](https://mushafuk.online/quran/)
- [Tafsir catalogue](https://mushafuk.online/tafsir.html)
- [Translation catalogue](https://mushafuk.online/translations/)
- [Search](https://mushafuk.online/ai/): finds a word in the mushaf, translations, tafsirs, i'rab and word meanings
- [Azerbaijani](https://mushafuk.online/az/)
- [Turkish](https://mushafuk.online/tr/)
- [English](https://mushafuk.online/en/)
- [Indonesian](https://mushafuk.online/id/)
- [Urdu](https://mushafuk.online/ur/)
- [French](https://mushafuk.online/fr/)
- [Bengali](https://mushafuk.online/bn/)
- [Malay](https://mushafuk.online/ms/)
- [Russian](https://mushafuk.online/ru/)

## Addresses on this host

- Arabic mushaf page n: https://mushafuk.online/page/n/ where n is 1–604
- Same page with an interface language: https://mushafuk.online/az/page/n/ and the same for tr, en, ru
- Word meanings: https://mushafuk.online/gharib/
- I'rab: https://mushafuk.online/irab/
- Recitation (seven readers): https://mushafuk.online/qiraat/
- About, sources, FAQ: https://mushafuk.online/about.html, https://mushafuk.online/sources.html, https://mushafuk.online/faq.html

Arabic tafsir pages live on https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/ (and https://t2.mushafuk.online/). Do not use https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/{id}/… — those paths are not on this host. Most translation books live on https://t.mushafuk.online/ and https://t1.mushafuk.online/. The catalogue at https://mushafuk.online/translations/ has the correct first link for each book. Do not invent a translator slug.

## Other Mushafuk hosts

- [Arabic tafsirs](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/): ayah-by-ayah commentaries
- [Translations](https://t.mushafuk.online/): Quran translations and translated tafsirs
- [More translations](https://t1.mushafuk.online/): further translation books
- [Further Arabic tafsirs](https://t2.mushafuk.online/)
- [Ulum al-Quran and usul](https://t3.mushafuk.online/): books on Quranic sciences and principles of tafsir
- [Quran Tasheeh](https://quran.mushafuk.online/): recitation practice with a microphone

## Languages

Interface languages on this host include Arabic, Azerbaijani, Turkish, English, Russian, Indonesian, Urdu, French, Bengali, and Malay. The mushaf text is Arabic.

- [Sitemap index](https://mushafuk.online/sitemap.xml): public HTML pages on this host

## Subdomains

Each host has its own llms.txt. Read that file, not this one, for pages on that host.

- [Tafsir, ayah by ayah](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Early tafsir](https://t2.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Usul and Ulum al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Translations](https://t.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Urdu, Bengali, Persian, Indonesian](https://t1.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Recitation check](https://quran.mushafuk.online/llms.txt)
- [Shamail, Bulugh, Mishkat, Nawawi](https://hadis.sunan.online/llms.txt). The ten larger hadith books are at https://sunan.online/llms.txt
